findings.title: Embedded-post author link swaps the light and dark lightness values
findings.body: This rule originally used scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change writes dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)), so the light-theme argument is 70% instead of the original 30% and the dark-theme argument is 30% instead of the complementary 70%. Light-theme embedded-post author links become much lighter than before and dark-theme links do not get the intended lightened secondary color. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

findings.title: Custom-message length swaps the light and dark lightness values
findings.body: This rule originally used scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). The change writes dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)), so the light-theme value changes from 70% to 30% and the dark-theme value is 70% instead of the complementary 30%. The hint text becomes much darker in light themes than before the PR. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)), as in the corresponding desktop modal rule.

findings.title: Topic-map heading changes the original 20% lightness to 50%
findings.body: The .topic-map h3 rule originally used scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). The change writes dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)), changing the light-theme color from 20% to 50% and giving dark themes 50% instead of the complementary 80%. Headings become noticeably lighter in light themes than intended. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%)), matching the desktop topic-map h3 rule.

findings.title: Group-member name changes the original 30% lightness to 50%
findings.body: The .group-member-info .name rule originally used scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change writes dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)), so the light-theme name color lightens from 30% to 50% and the dark-theme value is 50% instead of the complementary 70%. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).
